greek: Καὶ ἐκίνησεν ἐκεῖθεν Αβρααμ εἰς γῆν πρὸς λίβα καὶ ᾤκησεν ἀνὰ μέσον Καδης καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Σουρ καὶ παρῴκησεν ἐν Γεραροις.
hint: Abraham moves south and settles between Kadesh and Shur, sojourning in Gerar.

notes.text: [[flag]] The Hebrew is *ʾarṣâ hannegeb*, *to the land of the Negeb*. The Greek has *into land toward south-west wind*.
λίψ, one translation, *south-west wind*: plain text, as at 13:14.
κινέω, the chain of GEN 11:2, in the aorist.
Γεραρα declines here as a neuter plural, as Σόδομα does.

(Γεραρα, from Hebrew Gĕrār, of uncertain meaning)

greek: εἶπεν δὲ Αβρααμ περὶ Σαρρας τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ ὅτι Ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν· ἐφοβήθη γὰρ εἰπεῖν ὅτι Γυνή μού ἐστιν, μήποτε ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως διʼ αὐτήν. ἀπέστειλεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ βασιλεὺς Γεραρων καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Σαρραν.
hint: Abraham says of Sarah, She is my sister; Abimelech king of Gerar sends and takes her.

notes.lemma: ἐφοβήθη γὰρ εἰπεῖν ὅτι Γυνή μού ἐστιν, μήποτε ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως διʼ αὐτήν

Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take them for a proper name.

hint: God comes to Abimelech in a dream at night: you will die because of the woman you took; she has a husband.

hint: God in the dream: I knew you did it in a pure heart, and I spared you from sinning against me; so I did not let you touch her.

hint: Return the man's wife, for he is a prophet and will pray for you; if not, you and all yours will die.

hint: My land is before you; dwell wherever you please.

notes.text: οὗ, *where*, and ἐάν after it, `ever`, as at 6:17.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told]] [[name:Αβιμελεχ]] to [[name:Αβρααμ]] [[lo|lo, behold, see there]] [[the earth|the land, the dry ground, the terrestrial realm]] of me [[in the presence of|in the presence of, before, opposite and face to face, against]] of you; where ever to you [[may make good|may make good and make up, may make amends, may please and satisfy and flatter]], [[dwell in|dwell in, settle in, colonise, inhabit, settle and dwell, lie and be situate]].

greek: τῇ δὲ Σαρρα εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ δέδωκα χίλια δίδραχμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου· ταῦτα ἔσται σοι εἰς τιμὴν τοῦ προσώπου σου καὶ πάσαις ταῖς μετὰ σοῦ· καὶ πάντα ἀλήθευσον.
hint: To Sarah: I have given your brother a thousand didrachms, for the honour of your face and of all with you; and speak truth in all.

notes.lemma: εἰς τιμὴν τοῦ προσώπου σου … καὶ πάντα ἀλήθευσον
notes.text: [[flag]] The Hebrew is *hinnēh hûʾ-lāk kĕsût ʿênayim lĕkōl ʾăšer ʾittāk wĕʾēt kōl wĕnōkāḥat*, *it is for you a covering of the eyes for all who are with you, and before all you are set right*. The Greek has *for honour of your face and to all with you; and speak truth in all things*.
Middle Liddell is first *that which is paid in token of worth* or *value*.
ἀληθεύω, one active translation, *to speak truth*; the passive's *to come true* is left out: plain text.
Capitalised because it opens direct speech, as Rahlfs prints it; listed in `speech` so the checks do not take it for a proper name.

reading: [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand]], to [[name:Σαρρα]] [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told]] [[lo|lo, behold, see there]] [[I have given|I have given and it stands given, I have granted and it stands granted, I have provided and it stands provided, I have given over and delivered up and it stands so]] a thousand [[coins of two drachms|coins of two drachms, half-shekels]] [[to the son of the same mother|to the son of the same mother, to the brother, to the near kinsman]] of you; [[these|these, the nearer, what follows]] will be to you [[into|into, to, in, rest in]] [[that which is paid in token of worth|that which is paid in token of worth and value, worship and esteem and honour, honour and dignity and lordship, the prerogative, a dignity and office and magistracy, an authority and magistracy, a present of honour and offering, a reward and present, worth and value and price, payment, an estimate, compensation, the penalty, a valuation]] [[of the face|of the face, of the visage, of the countenance, of the look, of the outward appearance]] of you and [[to all|to all, to the whole, to every, to every single]] the [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of]] you; and [[all|all, the whole, every, every single]] speak truth.

greek: προσηύξατο δὲ Αβρααμ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ ἰάσατο ὁ θεὸς τὸν Αβιμελεχ καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς παιδίσκας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔτεκον·
hint: Abraham prays to God, and God heals Abimelech, his wife and his maids, and they bear children.

notes.text: The middle of ἰάομαι, *to heal, cure*; its aorist passive, *to be healed*, is left out.
τίκτω, the chain of GEN 4:1, in the plural.

reading: [[offered prayers|offered prayers and vows, addressed in prayer, offered prayers and worshipped, prayed for]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand]], [[name:Αβρααμ]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward]] [[the God|him who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only]], and [[healed|healed, cured]] [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only]] [[name:Αβιμελεχ]] and [[the woman|the woman, the mistress and lady, the wife and spouse]] of him and [[the young girls|the young girls, the maidens, the young slaves, the courtesans]] of him, and [[brought into the world|brought into the world, brought forth, bore, produced]];

greek: ὅτι συγκλείων συνέκλεισεν κύριος ἔξωθεν πᾶσαν μήτραν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ Αβιμελεχ ἕνεκεν Σαρρας τῆς γυναικὸς Αβρααμ.
hint: For the Lord had closed every womb in Abimelech's house because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

notes.text: The participle with the finite verb doubles συγκλείω, the chain of GEN 16:2, as the Hebrew *ʿāṣōr ʿāṣar*.
Middle Liddell tags only the Latin *matrix*; LSJ, *womb*.
[[flag]] Codex Alexandrinus alone leaves out the participle.

reading: [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as]] [[shutting|shutting and cooping up and hemming in and enclosing, setting together to fight as in the lists, shutting close and closing, locking, closing up, being well linked]] [[shut|shut and cooped up and hemmed in and enclosed, set together to fight as in the lists, shut close and closed, locked, closed up, was well linked]] [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over]] [[from without|from without, outside, without and free from]] [[all|all, the whole, every, every single]] [[womb|womb, the cervix including the orifice of the womb, matrix, source and origin, core and heart-wood, diseased condition, queen-wasp]] [[in the house|within, inside of, and by means of the house, the abode and dwelling, the room and chamber, the house of a god and temple, the household goods and substance, the household and family]] of [[name:Αβιμελεχ]] [[on account of|on account of, for the sake of, because of, for, as far as regards]] [[name:Σαρρας]] [[of the woman|of the woman, of the mistress and lady, of the wife and spouse]] [[name:Αβρααμ]].
